name: Exp Share
description: If any tower in a connected tower group has this mod, every tower in that group gains full XP when one gets a kill.

name: Scatter
description: This tower fires twice as many projectiles, each dealing half damage.

name: Life Link
description: This tower gains bonus maximum HP equal to adjacent towers' base maximum HP.

name: Silence Specialist
description: This tower creates half as much aggro when damaging enemies.

name: Hunker Down
description: This tower doubles fire rate but halves attack range.

name: Noisy
description: This tower constantly creates high threat to enemies inside its attack range.

name: Air Support
description: This tower prioritizes ranged enemies before other targets.

name: Cover Fire
description: Friendly troops inside this tower's attack range create no incidental aggro from damage, healing, or repairs.
